notes.title: Avatars, Leaderboards & Achievements!
notes.content:
Hello fellow Spinners!

First of all, I hope everyone is doing well considering the COVID-19 pandemic that is currently sweeping the world. Being cooped up inside the past few weeks has given me the motivation to create a small app update. Keep in mind, everything is and always will be completely free.

Let's dive right in!
Two new avatars have been added and can now be unlocked
A new quick restart feature has been added to right-click
Weekly leaderboards have been added (they reset every Sunday night at midnight PST)
The achievement requirements have been lowered from 1000 to 300
New app icon
The main menu looks better
The total number of leaderboard entries is now displayed on the leaderboard screen
'F' key now toggles fullscreen mode
Arcade Mode now unlocks at level 2 instead of 3
Fast Mode now unlocks at level 5 instead of 10
Insane Mode now unlocks at level 10 instead of 15
Minor bug fix to avoid visual pop when switching background
Improvements to the level generator


If anyone out there actually plays this game, give me a sign, or like, a high five emoji!

🙌(feel free to copy paste and comment below)
